title: Event color palette
description: As a user I want to choose a color for my events
acceptance_criteria: Earlier fixed palette superseded by PBI-021 and updated THM-09; history remains in Sprint 003

title: Shared UI for existing screens
description: As a user I want existing calendar and dialog controls to work consistently across screen widths
acceptance_criteria: Existing calendar and dialog portions of UIC-14 to UIC-17 and UIC-27 to UIC-37; keyboard resize; accessible names; narrow layouts; Cancel/Save and confirmation

title: Calendar event drag
description: As a user I want to move events by dragging
acceptance_criteria: CAL-03.a-d pass

title: Event dialog
description: As a user I want to open an event and add edit and remove my own events in a dialog
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01 to EVT-03 and EVT-07 and their sub-rows pass; clicking an event opens its details

title: Local event store
description: As a user I want my events kept on my device
acceptance_criteria: Events persist across restarts in UTC with their zones (TIM-01); a removed custom event can be undone (CAP-02)

title: Location address autocomplete
description: As a user I want addresses suggested while I type a location
acceptance_criteria: EVT-03.n passes; suggestions come from Photon (Product Owner decision 2026-11-22; hosting public or self-hosted still to decide); the map button keeps opening Google Maps (EVT-03.a)

title: Readable different-end-time-zone label
description: As a user, I want the different-end-time-zone option to stay readable in a narrow dialog
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01.j: show the full label at 12 px when it fits; otherwise show a localized short label (for example, Different end TZ) at 12 px before ellipsis; keep paired time fields aligned.

title: Non-color theme components
description: As a user I want consistent icons control sizes visual states and spacing
acceptance_criteria: Active non-color rows in THM-03 through THM-08 on existing UI; verify representative components and reduced motion

title: Shared UI for future screens
description: As a user I want the same shared controls in added screens
acceptance_criteria: Remaining UIC-14 to UIC-17 and UIC-27 to UIC-37 from PBI-010 as dependent features land

title: Expanded calendar print options
description: As a user I want to print calendar periods and options beyond the current view
acceptance_criteria: Remaining CAL-05 and PRT-01/02 calendar rows after PBI-022

title: Restore and verify the VS Code preview
description: The Product Owner could not verify Sprint 005 in the VS Code integrated browser because the preview stayed blank after restart
acceptance_criteria: Open SuiteStream at 127.0.0.1:8080 in the shared VS Code browser; confirm the calendar renders and verify the #93B4FF seeded theme and reminder resize with the Product Owner; record any startup errors

title: Reconcile requirements with Sprint 005
description: As the Product Owner I want requirement rows and tests to show what Sprint 005 delivered
acceptance_criteria: Delivered rows have status and cited tests; THM-02.e contrast and Google colour-ID mapping restored; retirements listed for PO decision

title: Tested app bootstrap
description: As a developer I want startup logic tested and out of main.dart
acceptance_criteria: Startup sample data and migration moved to a tested bootstrap; no app-wide ListenableBuilder

title: Cancel/Save confirmation sequence
description: As a user I want Saved and Cancelled feedback before a dialog closes
acceptance_criteria: UIC-27.a/.c/.e and THM-06.c on existing dialogs with reduced motion; slice of PBI-010

title: Shared size and radius tokens
description: As a user I want consistent control sizes and corners
acceptance_criteria: THM-04.a-d on existing dialogs and calendar header with tests; slice of PBI-019

title: Dialog overflow at narrow widths
description: As a user I want dialogs usable at narrow widths and large text
acceptance_criteria: UIC-14 and UIC-36 on existing dialogs at 320/400/800 px and 2x text; slice of PBI-010

title: Close Sprint 003 and 004 reviews
description: As the Product Owner I want PBI-011/013/014/018 reviewed and closed
acceptance_criteria: Each cites its row IDs and passing tests; remainder of partly built PBI-013 becomes a new PBI

title: Compact aligned Add/Edit event dialog
description: As a user I want the event dialog compact with aligned fields
acceptance_criteria: Matches scrum/sprint006/reference/add_event_target.png: 34 px text boxes; label above field; paired fields equal width and aligned; Notes level with Title and ending at the Time zone field; Link to row full width; Cancel|Save bottom right; spacing only from theme tokens except alignment fixes

title: Restore the calendar event color palette
description: As a user I want events and calendars to use the agreed Google color palette
acceptance_criteria: THM-09 and UIC-10/UIC-20 as restored by the Product Owner on 2026-11-23: picker offers the 11 event colors and the 24 calendar colors; nearest-color mapping for sync; defaults per EVT-03.i; the theme seed (THM-02) stays app-theme only; replaces the theme-derived picker from Sprint 005

title: Light / Dark / Match system theme choice
description: As a user I want to choose a light or dark theme or follow my system
acceptance_criteria: SHL-03 to SHL-03.c: one icon with a menu like the view picker; saved on the device; page starts in the saved theme without flashing another

title: Settings reorganised: Calendar and Theme panes
description: As a user I want defaults under Settings > Calendar and look-and-feel under Settings > Theme
acceptance_criteria: Settings > Calendar holds the defaults (default event length with its unit of time - currently missing; default time; default time zone); Settings > Theme holds animation duration (button durations) and the default theme setting; reconcile SET-03.c and SET-10 (animation setting currently in General)

title: Settings stored in the database and shared across devices
description: As a user I want my settings to follow me to every device
acceptance_criteria: All settings (view choices
size: defaults) are stored in the database and loaded on every device; today they are saved on the device only; needs the storage/sync decision (PBI-017 hosting); device-only items stay device-only where a requirement says so

title: Print feature completion
description: As a user I want to print any period and one event
acceptance_criteria: All print rows now in print.md (PRT-*): full paper range and Print All; Itinerary; two-month printing; print one event in Day view; native printing; Print button placement under the print feature

title: Remaining Sprint 005 shared UI and theme work
description: As a user I want every common control to follow the shared standards and be configurable
acceptance_criteria: Remaining PBI-010/019 rows: per-control sizes; state and status animations; popup shadow as a common UI (UIC); a Settings > Theme setting for every common UI element; header zone fit as a common standard; one text-box and dropdown height verified site-wide incl. reminder rows; delete-occupied-calendar and placeholder Settings panes

title: Finish the calendar requirements
description: As the Product Owner I want the calendar feature complete
acceptance_criteria: Every calendar.md row is done or has a visible placeholder where it needs another feature (rules
size: Google sync): audit the 47 backlog rows against tests; build real gaps (CAL-04.d hour height; CAL-09.e/f marks) ; placeholders (stub UI plus requirement note naming the missing feature) for the rest; status and test cited for each row

title: Settings > Admin: add and remove test data
description: As the Product Owner I want to add or remove pregenerated test calendars from Settings
acceptance_criteria: Admin section at the bottom of the Settings menu; Add test calendars creates 3 calendars with about 8 events each across November 2026 (timed all-day multi-day overlapping some with reminders); adding twice does not duplicate; Remove test data asks for confirmation and deletes only the test calendars and their events; first-run automatic sample data is removed; all text in the arb files
